entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
This miscellaneous second appeal under Section 71(6) of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006,
has been filed against the order dated 14.11.2025 passed by IX ADJ District Gwalior in RCA No.270/2024 by which the order dated 18/07/2023 passed by Adjudicating Officer cum Additional District Magistrate Gwalior in case No.Q/khad suraksha/63/2023 has been modified and the penalty of Rs.50,000/- has been reduced to Rs.25000/-.

After arguing the matter at length and in view of the fact that two months had not expired from the date of filing of an application for grant of license as provided under Section 31 of the Food Safety And Standards Act, the Counsel for appellant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this appeal.
It is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE Aman Jain Oil Mil Nayaganj Anaj Mandi Kila ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 30 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102520967/
